headline: MVP App Development: Process, Timeline and Cost (2026 Guide)
description: A practical guide to MVP app development: what an MVP is, the six steps from idea to launch, how long each takes, indicative cost ranges and the mistakes to avoid.

itemListElement.name: MVP App Development: Process, Timeline and Cost (2026 Guide)

acceptedAnswer.text: It is building the smallest working version of an app that lets real users complete its core action, so you can measure demand before investing in a full product.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an MVP app?

acceptedAnswer.text: About 7 weeks for a lean MVP and 10 to 16 weeks for most MVPs that include payments, an admin side and a custom backend, depending on features and design.

mainEntity.name: How much does an MVP app cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using our method, roughly $13k to $22k for a lean MVP and $27k to $48k for a funded MVP with payments, an admin dashboard and a custom API. These are indicative ranges.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a prototype and an MVP?

acceptedAnswer.text: A prototype shows how the app would look or flow and cannot really be used. An MVP is working software that real users can use to complete the core action.

mainEntity.name: Should an MVP be built for iOS and Android?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually yes, from one shared codebase, because the second platform adds little extra work. Launch on one platform first only if your users are clearly concentrated there.
